## 7. Packet use rule

The auditor must reason from these exact full files and the frozen prompt. If a claim cannot be established from the frozen packet, it must be labeled unsupported or unresolved rather than repaired with outside literature or general knowledge.

Any proposed missing-source defect may identify an evidence-class gap, but no newly found paper may be treated as canonical FCP evidence without a separately authorized source intake or re-audit.
